integrity: A direct elementary-simplicial-collapse and homotopy-pushout proof establishes every infinite-family assertion. The attached finite test suite was executed and is reproduced byte-for-byte. The un-restored endpoint is known prior work, acknowledged as such.
scientific_limitations: Requires a universal vertex on each opposite bipartition side; the crown restoration result assumes n at least four. The homotopy decomposition is not a canonical simplicial collapse of the entire complex. Ordinary homotopy and degree-two integral homology maps are classified, not all induced homotopy maps. Bibliographic priority remains subject to unindexed literature; no independent scientific audit has occurred.
title: An edge-restoration transition for closed-neighborhood complexes of crown graphs
